description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'VertxMockSupport' providing static helper methods for mocking and matching Vert.x handlers in tests using Mockito and ArgumentCaptor.

classes.name: VertxMockSupport
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to facilitate mocking and argument capturing of Vert.x Handler objects in unit tests.

methods.name: anyHandler
methods.description: Returns an ArgumentMatcher that matches any non-null Handler of the specified type.

methods.name: mockHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a mock instance of a Handler of the specified type.

methods.name: argumentCaptorHandler
methods.description: Provides an ArgumentCaptor for capturing Handler instances during testing.
